data.title: 卡莲 · 修道院回廊的微风回眸
data.description: 【卡莲 · 修道院回廊的微风回眸】春日明媚的修道院石柱长廊外，微风吹拂着庭院盛开的花草。卡莲身着无裙祭服漫步于石柱之间，微风吹动她长长的红色抹大拉圣骸布饰带与银白发丝，勾勒出修长挺拔的腿部线条。她停下脚步微微侧过身回眸，嘴角扬起一抹罕见而清澈的浅笑——「今天的风很舒服呢。如果是和你一起漫步的话，我倒是不介意走得更远一点。」
data.location: 阳光穿透哥特拱廊的古老修道院回廊石柱间
data.action: 漫步于石柱长廊间手扶石柱侧身回眸，红丝带随风轻扬，神情清冷温柔
data.lighting: 拱门透射进来的明朗金色阳光与石柱长影
data.camera: cowboy shot, eye level, elegant cloister portrait
data.promptProse: Between successive Gothic columns, Caren Hortensia pauses with one hand resting against the nearest stone shaft and turns back with a small, quiet smile. Preserve her black-and-white skirtless clerical vestment, detached sleeves and dark thigh-highs; the long crimson Shroud ribbons lift beside her silver hair without wrapping around her face. Her amber-yellow eyes look toward the viewer. The eye-level cowboy view follows the paving joints along the colonnade, with the courtyard garden visible through the next arch. Afternoon sunlight crosses the open arches onto her sleeve and the pale stone floor. Pillars cast long alternating bands across the walkway, while reflected stone light softens the shaded cheek and the farther arches lose contrast.
